The launch, announced at the Saudi Facility Management Association (SFMA) Conference & Exhibition, extends AJi Group's expertise into the operational phase of the asset lifecycle. Image Courtesy: AJi Group

Showcased at the Saudi Facility Management Association (SFMA) Conference & Exhibition, AJi FM underlines the Group’s commitment to supporting the goals of Saudi Vision 2030

Press Release

  • Advanced FM capabilities will contribute long-term value to the valuable assets being developed in the Kingdom
  • AJi FM extends the Group’s expertise into the operational phase of the asset lifecycle, through a diversified portfolio of Facilities Management services

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia: AJi Group, the region's premier architecture, project management, engineering and consultancy group, today announced the establishment of AJi FM, a dedicated Facilities Management arm headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The launch, announced at the Saudi Facility Management Association (SFMA) Conference & Exhibition, extends AJi Group's expertise into the operational phase of the asset lifecycle. It adds a diversified portfolio of world-class Facilities Management services that are designed to safeguard the long-term performance and value of built assets.

Approved by AJi Group's Board of Directors and Group CEO, and developed with AJi Group's Business Development team, AJi FM is part of the Group's wider strategic growth ambitions, and reflects the commitment to supporting the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, under which facilities management is positioned as a growing pillar of Saudi Arabia's built-asset economy.

Eng. Hamzeh Awwad, CEO of AJi Group, said: “The establishment of AJi FM builds on our knowledge as designers, project managers and our strong involvement in the region’s infrastructure development. The decisions we make at the design stage carry through to construction and, ultimately, to the life cycle cost and functionality of the asset. By extending that attention into the operational phase, AJi FM will help achieve higher operational efficiencies and create long-term value for assets. Launching AJi FM in Saudi Arabia underliens our long-term commitment to the Kingdom’s growth strategy.”

AJi FM is one of the few dedicated Facilities Management arms established under an engineering consultancy umbrella in the region. It reflects AJi Group's deep understanding of the Saudi market and the Kingdom’s growth and development trajectory, positioning AJi Group as a holistic enterprise providing expert counsel and services across the full asset lifecycle.

 AJi Group already delivers  advanced engineering services spanning design, construction supervision and project management through its six verticals — Urban Environment, Wellness and Healthcare, Utilities and Environment, Mobility and Transportation, Eco-Futurism, and Advisory and Solutions. AJi FM extends that offering through to the operational phase, giving clients a single point of accountability from inception to completion, rather than a handover between separate design, construction and operations partners.

Add Eng.Yazan Shahwan, Director of Aji Saudi Business Development Group said:

: “AJi FM positions our Group as a fully integrated enterprise across the full asset lifecycle. Clients now have access to engineering services spanning design, construction supervision and project management, extended through to operations, all under one accountable partner. With AJi FM, our clients can move seamlessly from design, construction supervision and project management into the operational phase under one group.

Majed Zeitun, Advisory Consultant at AJi FM, said: “Facilities Management is where the long-term value of a built asset is protected. AJi FM gives clients a dedicated, specialised partner, backed by the same engineering rigour that shapes our projects from design through construction. It closes the gap between project handover and full operational readiness, giving our clients a single, accountable partner across the complete asset lifecycle.”

Operating through 13 offices across the MENA region with a professional team of 1,500 employees across 25 markets, AJi Group brings a 65-year legacy. With sustainability and innovation at its core, AJi Group specializes in developing sustainable communities where environmental, social and governance principles help build an inclusive future. The Group's vision is centered around three pillars: strengthening its legacy, nurturing talented professionals, and partnering in shaping the region's future.

About AJi Group 

AJi Group is the region's premier architecture, construction, engineering and consultancy group, operating through 13 offices across the MENA region. With a 65-year legacy and a professional team of 1,500 employees across 25 markets, the Group delivers services through six verticals: Urban Environment, Wellness and Healthcare, Utilities and Environment, Mobility and Transportation, Eco-Futurism and Advisory and Solutions. The Group's vision is centred around three core pillars: strengthening its legacy, nurturing talented professionals, and partnering in shaping the region's future. With sustainability and innovation at its core, AJi Group specializes in developing sustainable communities where environmental, social, and governance principles help build an inclusive future.
